description: The plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output across different layers. The x-axis is labeled “Layer” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 21, with tick labels at integer values. The y-axis is labeled “Sparsity Ratio” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 0.8, with tick labels at 0.2 intervals. A dashed blue line, labeled “sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.003”, begins at approximately 0.8 at layer 0 and declines to approximately 0.02 at layer 21. A dotted orange line, labeled “sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.126”, begins at approximately 0.75 at layer 0 and declines to approximately 0.08 at layer 21. A dashed green line, labeled “sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.080”, begins at approximately 0.6 at layer 0 and declines to approximately 0.05 at layer 21.
